rows.label: tlk43300061_01_msg0001
rows.name:
Hey. Are you sightseeing too? My
family and I are traveling as well.
We took it easy in Iyasaki.

rows.label: tlk43300061_01_msg0002
rows.name:
But we've spent longer waiting at the
port than we actually spent in the
village. It's a problem.

rows.label: tlk43300061_01_msg0003
rows.name:
They told us there are boats to
Superbia from Rijite Port, but...

rows.label: tlk43300061_01_msg0004
rows.name:
I don't think I can take my whole
family across that ridge of the
Cloud Sea...

rows.label: tlk43300061_01_msg0005
rows.name:
And besides, we're Invidian. Going
to Superbia would be a little...
